hypothesis.statement: On real eyes-closed 64-channel EEG (eegmmidb S002R02), bandPower(method='welch') reproduces scipy.signal.welch (symmetric Hann, nperseg=256, noverlap=128, detrend=False, scaling='density') integrated over the identical EEG-band indices, BIT-FOR-BIT across all 64 channels x 5 bands; and relative alpha power is highest over the posterior (parieto-occipital) region where the eyes-closed alpha rhythm dominates.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), all 64 EEG channels, first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: the Welch band powers equal scipy.signal.welch (matched conventions) to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across all 64 channels x 5 bands, AND relative alpha is highest posteriorly
